title: Le matin
subtitle: A late breakfast at home
register: casual (tu), a mother and her child
review: Dialogue from the user (morning.md). English translations, questions and notes by Claude: check them.
intro: It's ten o'clock and the child has only just got up. Listen first with the text hidden. Then show it and listen again.

lines.text: Bonjour, la marmotte ! Enfin ! Tu as faim ?

tr.en: Morning, sleepyhead! At last! Are you hungry?

lines.text: Oui, j'ai faim. Oh, il est déjà dix heures !

tr.en: Yes, I'm hungry. Oh, it's already ten o'clock!

lines.text: Tu veux quoi pour le petit-déjeuner ?

tr.en: What do you want for breakfast?

lines.text: Je peux avoir du pain perdu et deux œufs au plat ?

tr.en: Can I have French toast and two fried eggs?

lines.text: Bien sûr. Et tu veux boire quoi ?

tr.en: Of course. And what do you want to drink?

lines.text: Je voudrais un jus d'orange frais. On a des oranges ?

tr.en: I'd like a fresh orange juice. Do we have any oranges?

lines.text: On a deux oranges. Je vais te faire un jus.

tr.en: We have two oranges. I'll make you a juice.

lines.text: Merci, maman. Il est où, papa ?
Il promène le chien au parc. Il rentre dans cinq minutes. Aujourd'hui, il va t'emmener chez le coiffeur.

tr.en: He's walking the dog in the park. He'll be back in five minutes. Today he's taking you to the hairdresser's.

lines.text: D'accord. Mmm, c'est très bon ! Je n'ai plus faim. Je vais m'habiller.

tr.en: OK. Mmm, it's really good! I'm not hungry any more. I'm going to get dressed.

notes: la marmotte = the marmot, an animal that sleeps all winter. A teasing name for someone who sleeps late.
Tu veux quoi ? Il est où, papa ? The question word goes last: normal in spoken French.
Je vais te faire un jus, il va t'emmener, je vais m'habiller: aller + infinitive talks about the near future.
Je n'ai plus faim = I'm not hungry any more. ne ... plus = no longer.
pain perdu = French toast (literally 'lost bread': stale bread saved with egg and milk). œufs au plat = fried eggs.
chez le coiffeur = to the hairdresser's. chez + a person = at or to their place.
